model.support: All components fixed on every face in z=0
model.geometry: Original single solid, unchanged coordinates and mm units
model.elements: Isoparametric curved 10-node tetrahedra, quadratic displacement; volume integration order 4, seat integration order 5

extraction.seat_mean_displacement_mm: Integral of -uz over the actual loaded face divided by its integrated area. Traction specified as 1.98728 MPa, rounded source total = 9999.99296 N.
extraction.max_displacement_mm: Maximum Euclidean displacement at all P2 nodes (vertices and edge nodes); volume quadrature maximum also checked.

fields_schema.node_ids: Gmsh node tags, matched to FE quadratic DOF coordinate order
fields_schema.reaction_forces_N: (nnode,3) K u - f; nonzero only on supports up to numerical residual
fields_schema.gmsh_tetrahedron_node_ids: (nelem,10), original Gmsh connectivity using node tags
fields_schema.skfem_element_vertex_node_ids: (nelem,4) Gmsh tags of corners in FE order; maps quadrature arrays to mesh by vertex set
fields_schema.quadrature_stress_MPa: (nelem,nquad,6) components xx yy zz xy yz xz (tensor shear), not nodally averaged
